channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Northern Plains Flow Features
item.description: This observation shows features that look like a flow margin around a kipuka, so this is definitely worth a closer look. A “kipuka”, a Hawaiian term, is an area of land that is surrounded by younger lava flows, in effect an “island” within a sea of lava. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
